jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

How you'll contribute:

• Architect and develop backend applications and distributed systems to build internal and external support systems and databases

• Write reusable, testable, and efficient code

• See through a project from conception to finished product

• Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system

• Meet both technical and consumer needs

• Locate and define new process improvement opportunities

• Work in a team of Scientists, Data Analysts, and Front and Backend Developers in a collaborative way

What you'll bring:

• Minimum 3 years of experience

• Proficiency with one of the following scripting languages: Python or R

• Proficiency with databases SQL/ NoSQL

• Version control using Git / comfortable with Linux / bash scripting

• Attention to detail

• Good communication and team-work skills

• Excellent verbal and written English are a MUST

• Excellent problem-solving skills.

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Backend
jobs_results.location: Santiago de Compostela, Municipality of Santiago de Compostela, Spain
jobs_results.description:
Objetivo

Analizar, diseñar, desarrollar, desplegar y mantener sistemas y aplicaciones con alta disponibilidad que permitan la automatización de tareas y procesos de fabricación y el registro y análisis de la información generada mediante la toma de requisitos, diseño de la arquitectura e implementación del software, bajo la supervisión del Responsable de Ingeniería de Ajuste y Verificación, con el objetivo de lograr la optimización del proceso, eficiencia en los tiempos de ejecución y reducción de costes.

Funciones
• Realizar el análisis del alcance del proyecto, recopilar y especificar los requisitos del proyecto, diseñar y la arquitectura identificando los diferentes módulos y sus interacciones así como modelar la base de datos.
• Realizar la implementación de las funcionalidades identificadas haciendo uso del lenguaje de programación adecuado.
• Diseñar un plan de pruebas unitarias y de integración para su posterior ejecución y análisis

Perfil
• Grado en Ingeniería Informática ó... Telecomunicación. Valorable especialidad telemática y Máster en Ingeniería.
• Conocimientos en:
• Programación web (javascript, html5, css) ,
• Programación backend (python + flask, PhP),
• Interfaces de comunicación: ApiREST, Publica/Subscribe,
• Tecnologías de despliegue basadas en contenedores software (Docker)
• Diseño diagramas de arquitectura e interacción
• Control de versiones (git)
• Diseño de bases de datos (lenguaje SQL)

Se ofrece
• Incorporación inmediata y estable a una corporación multinacional gallega que sigue creciendo e invirtiendo en I+D más del 7% de sus beneficios.
• Formación continua y adaptada a las necesidades de cada trabajador
• Flexibilidad horaria que permite conciliar y gestionar tu tiempo.
• Modalidad híbrida con 2 días teletrabajo a la semana.
• Paquete de Retribución Flexible, Fisioterapia in house, Catering, y muchos otros beneficios

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Backend
jobs_results.description:
Hey there! Let us introduce ourselves!

We're Doofinder and we were born to make the technologies that companies of any size from around the world need to grow more affordable. Our team has developed since 2011 the top search engine for website and e-commerce, that helps retailers online to increase their sales.

We are agile, open, inclusive and customer-centric. But above it all, in Doofinder people come first. We are a company with people of many different nationalities, cultures and languages. We sell all over the world and speak the language of our customers. That makes our environment a place where we learn every day: we are enriched by the origin, culture, and personal history of very different people who have a common dream – to make powerful, affordable products and to contribute to the sustainable future of our thousands of customers.

We are looking for a self-motivated and dedicated Back-end Engineer. You will be part of a smart, innovative and experienced team with a... broad range of skills and a really sociable and positive attitude. We will consider applicants with, at least, 1-2 years experienced in the technologies listed below.

🔎 Key Responsibilities:
• Software engineering with a healthy dose of performance engineering.
• Develop and maintain backend systems.
• Work within your team and with others to ensure the overall vision of the project is being fulfilled.
• Permission to work within the EU is a must.

📋 Required Skills and Experience:
• Permission to work within the EU is a must.
• Demonstrable experience of 2 years in Back-end environments. (Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Python or similar).
• Collaborates well in a team environment.
• Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to new environments.
• Good English communication skills, both spoken and written.

💡 Bonus points for any of the following:
• Experience developing with Elixir.
• Expertise with Phoenix framework.
• Experience with a variety of Amazon Web Services (AWS).
• Experience working with Python and Django.

What could you expect from Doofinder?

🏠 Real stability with a permanent contract (Indefinido) in an innovative and rapid growth company with a future project on e-commerce industry.

💰Competitive salary

🚀 Career plans and professional development

🖥️ The most innovative and unique technology & tools

🌍 International environment with over 33 different nationalities.

✈️ 22 days of Annual Leave (plus 24-31 December as discretionary days)

❤️ Health Care Plan after Probationary period completed

🚶 Doofinder also, compensates referrals so, you could benefit when you refer new professionals, colleagues & friends.

🏡 Real Work Life Balance (flexibility & WFH policy) with Friday's afternoon - Off

For non-junior profiles there is the possibility of WFH outside of Madrid, with the requirement of coming once a month to our office in Madrid (Doofinder pays for the travel and accommodation) and for specific events such as onboarding or training.

🍎 Fruit, snacks & monthly Pizza - News at the office

🏓 Communities & activities Outdoors: ping- pong, footbol, golf, chess, etc.

🪴 Green environment and open spaces in a very cool and modern office.

🎮 Needing some disconnection from work? Please, go and play some arcade games at our office!

🚀Afterhours chats, role plays- interactions and much more!

📧 If you would like to know more, do not hesitate to apply and we’ll get in touch to fill you on details. We will be delighted to know you

jobs_results.description:
¿Te gustaría desarrollar tu carrera profesional en el sector financiero y bancario? DOMINION DIGITAL está en búsqueda de un/a DESARROLLADOR/A BACKEND, para incorporar a su equipo de Bilbao, para un nuevo proyecto tecnológico.Se trata de una empresa especializada en tecnología, digitalización e innovación, con sedes en Bilbao y Madrid, y perteneciente a DOMINION, una compañía global de proyectos y servicios integrales con más de 12.500 trabajadores y más de 1.000 clientes distribuidos en 35 países.¿Te interesa? Si es así, ¡sigue leyendo!¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?- Desarrollo de Backenden Java (Spring) sobre proyectos relacionados con el sector bancario, empleando tanto API Rest como SOAP.- Realización de consultas SQL a través del motor Oracle.¿Con que competencias te necesitamos?- Titulación: Grado en Ingeniería de Tecnologías de Telecomunicación, Ingeniería Informática o Grado Superior en Informática (DAM, DAW).- Conocimiento sobre desarrollo de Backend en Java a través de... Spring.- Experiencia en realización de peticiones contra la base de datos a través de Oracle.Valoraremos…- Experiencia en diseño API First.- Persona resolutiva, creativa, con capacidad de escucha, analítica y con atención al detalle.- Capacidad de trabajo en equipo.- Experiencia en el sector financiero y bancario.- Conocimientos de SQL.¿Qué ofrecemos?- Incorporación a un proyecto colaborativo en continuo desarrollo.- Horario de trabajo flexible, con jornada intensiva de verano y viernes intensivos de 8:00-15:00.- Plan de formación y desarrollo.- Buen ambiente de trabajo.- Condiciones salariales a negociar en función de la experiencia aportada y perfil profesional.- Lugar de trabajo: Bilbao centro (se requerirá que el/la candidato/a pueda acudir a las oficinas, ya que será un proyecto presencial).

Se requerirá una experiencia mínima de 6 meses en Desarrollo de Backenden Java (Spring) sobre proyectos relacionados con el sector bancario y en la realización de consultas SQL a través del motor Oracle.

Spring.- Experiencia en realización de peticiones contra la base de datos a través de Oracle.Valoraremos…- Experiencia en diseño API First.- Persona resolutiva, creativa, con capacidad de escucha, analítica y con atención al detalle.- Capacidad de trabajo en equipo.- Experiencia en el sector financiero y bancario.- Conocimientos de SQL.¿Qué ofrecemos?- Incorporación a un proyecto colaborativo en continuo desarrollo.- Horario de trabajo flexible, con jornada intensiva de verano y viernes intensivos de 8:00-15:00.- Plan de formación y desarrollo.- Buen ambiente de trabajo.- Condiciones salariales a negociar en función de la experiencia aportada y perfil profesional.- Lugar de trabajo: Bilbao centro (se requerirá que el/la candidato/a pueda acudir a las oficinas, ya que será un proyecto presencial).

Se requerirá una experiencia mínima de 6 meses en Desarrollo de Backenden Java (Spring) sobre proyectos relacionados con el sector bancario y en la realización de consultas SQL a través del motor Oracle.

jobs_results.title: Backend Software Engineer​/Java - Payroll
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Backend Software Engineer (Java) - Payroll
About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, more freedom. And since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. With an arsenal of awesome products that span spending, saving, travel, transfers, investing, exchanging and more, we've helped 40+ million customers get more from their money. And we're not done yet.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ two things are essential to continuing our success: our people and our culture. We've been officially certified as a Great Place to Work in recognition of our outstanding employee experience! So far, we have 8,000+ people working around the world, from our great offices or remotely, on our mission. And we're looking for more. We want brilliant people that love building great products, love redefining success, and love turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our... Technology team isn’t just one of the best in the industry, it’s one of the best in the world. And we’re proud of it. It’s our driving force — our engine From building a new financial backend to creating an award-winning app, there’s nothing (and we mean nothing) our tech team can’t do.

Our Technology team isn’t here to fix legacy systems — it’s here to build world-class financial products from the ground up. Products that'll be used by millions of people around the world We’re looking for a Backend Engineer with an entrepreneurial mindset to become a founding engineer building our Payroll product from the ground up.

If you like to work at a steady pace with no surprises, keep scrolling. If you want to work on something 0 to 1 in the B2B space, with the empowerment to shape the product and bring it to life, supported by other world-class operators, you might be just who we’re looking for. Sound like your speed? Let’s chat Our technology stack:

Java 17

GCPKubernetes Docker Postgre SQLRedis Spark Java JOOQ and TDD approach

What you’ll be doing

Shaping the vision and direction for the Payroll product, pushing the boundaries to become a best in-class product within the B2B Revolut ecosystem

Devising and building innovative features from scratch, shipping solutions that are not only functional but also elegant and scalable

Owning dedicated modules within the Payroll product, and leading technical scoping with the frontend and backend team for your modules

Building a high-performance core payroll engine and integrations with other HR softwares

Creating robust data pipelines to power reporting, data science, and analytics

What you'll need Fluency with Java6+ years of experience in back-end development

A bachelor's degree in computer science, maths, physics, or similar field of study

To be a quick learner with an ambitious attitude and results-driven personality

The ability to work well as part of a team in a fast-paced environment

Excellent communication and organisational skills

Fluency in English Nice to have

Experience with Kotlin and Scala Experience building payroll (or broader HR) products

Experience in a start-up or scale-up Experience in a product-focused environment

Compensation range

Vilnius: 4,900 - 7,500 gross monthly
• Lithuania: 4,900 - 7,500 gross monthly
• Other locations:
Compensation will be discussed during the interview process
• Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers.

That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Refer to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates for details on our data handling practices during your application
